labels.rationale: Dependency advisory (CVE-2026-4539) about Pygments, not Rich's own code.

body:
This advisory concerns the Pygments dependency, not Rich's own code, so the fix belongs with the Pygments project. Earlier report of the same advisory: #4044.

Private vulnerability reports about Rich go through SECURITY.md:
https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
